messages:
jamie: FYI — staging project `redwood-staging-asia` is hitting GPU quota and VPC IP exhaustion in asia-southeast1. We need 8x A100 (v4) GPUs and +200 internal IP quota. I opened a GCP case CS0123456789 but it's P4 right now. Load test scheduled Tue 10am PT, we need P2 escalation. Details below.

sophia: Case number + link?

jamie: Case: CS0123456789 — https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/CS0123456789
Project: redwood-staging-asia (org: rwd-prod-org). Requested quotas: `a100-gpu` region quota 8 -> current 0, subnetwork IP allocation +200. Attached output:
```
$ gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --project=redwood-staging-asia
quotas:
- A100_GPUS: limit 0, usage 0
- IN_USE_ADDRESSES: limit 256, usage 256
```

mike: on it. pinged TAM and partner rep (michelle@partner). asked for escalation — will follow up with support rep email. Can you add exact VM shape? (a2-highgpu-1g?).

jamie: we'll use `a2-highgpu-8g` (8x A100 v4). Also need firewall rule update for internal subnet 10.128.0.0/17 expanded. I filed a secondary networking case: CS0123456790.

gcp-case-bot: Case CS0123456789 status: OPEN. Last updated: Awaiting internal review. Priority: P4.

sophia: Can we move the load test to us-central1 as a fallback tomorrow to avoid blocking the release? latency budget is 220ms so probably ok for the test.

tanvi: Not ideal — we need asia latency numbers specifically. If support can't escalate before Tue, we'll gate the test. Recommend we also open AWS sandbox in ap-southeast-1 as backup.

mike: Escalation request sent (email thread ID: 43567). Asked TAM to make it P2 citing upcoming external customer demo. cc'ing @michelle.

jamie: added escalation note in the case, asked for interim quota increase for 4 GPUs so at least partial test can run. Also requested temporary subnet expansion by 24h.

gcp-case-bot: Case CS0123456789 update: Support rep replied — need project-level billing verification + VM list. Reply with command:
```
gcloud projects describe redwood-staging-asia --format=json
```

jamie: sending billing proof and VM list now. attaching invoice id INV-2026-443.

sophia: thanks. I'll own follow-up with billing proof and confirm when support replies. :thumbsup: 

tanvi: I'm updating the test plan to allow partial run with 4 GPUs. If full 8 not available, we'll mark metrics to compare.

mike: noting action items:
- mike: escalate with TAM (done)
- jamie: send billing + VM list (done)
- sophia: monitor case + push P2
- tanvi: adjust test plan

jamie: thanks all. will post updates here. :eyes: 

gcp-case-bot: Case CS0123456789 status: UPDATED -> P2 (Escalated by TAM). ETA support action: 6 hours.

sophia: nice. I'll schedule the load test for Tue 10am PT but mark as tentative until we get final confirmation.

jamie: last note — keep thread pinned for on-call. If not resolved by 9am PT Tue, we'll failover to us-central1.

mike: copied. closing loop once quota shows applied.
